name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: prompt rewriting, copy buttons and tl;dr for replies, and a jump list for long sessions

plugins.name: prompt-boost
plugins.description: Put ++ at the start or end of a prompt to have it rewritten into a clear prompt for review before sending

plugins.name: reply-tools
plugins.description: Copy buttons on code blocks and a one-click tl;dr of long replies

plugins.name: jump-list
plugins.description: A side pane listing every prompt in the session: see where you are, click to jump back
